turns.replyText:
To get the absolute best result from your Tumble rug, the most important thing to pair it with is our cushioned, non-slip rug pad. Every Tumble rug set actually comes with this pad because it’s essential for comfort, stability, and preventing any bunching or sliding. 🙂

Beyond the pad, getting the right size and layout is key to making the room feel complete. For a living room, we usually recommend a size that allows at least the front legs of your furniture to rest on the rug. In a dining room, having about 24-30 inches of rug extending beyond the table ensures chairs stay on the rug even when pulled out.

If you're looking for that perfect, high-quality look, I also suggest:

turns.replyText:
I'm happy to share some tips to ensure your Tumble rug looks and performs its best in your home!

Assembly
Our rugs use a simple, velcro-free system. You'll start by locking the puzzle-piece rug pad together on your floor. Once the pad is set, simply lay the rug cover over it and tuck the corners of the pad into the rug's built-in corner pockets. This keeps everything flat and prevents those annoying curled corners.

Care and Cleaning
For daily maintenance, we recommend using a vacuum with low suction or a setting for hard floors to keep the fibers looking great. If you have a spill, don't worry, the liquid will bead up on the surface, allowing you to wipe it away easily. When it’s time for a deeper clean, the rug cover can go right into your household washer and dryer on a cold, gentle cycle.

Pro-Tip for Creases
If you notice any persistent creases from shipping, you can use a low-heat iron over a damp cloth to smooth them right out.
